style: high-energy modern sing-along pop for families, 122 bpm, bright major key, punchy drums and big handclaps, bouncy synth bass, ukulele and glockenspiel hooks, warm friendly male lead vocal with a cheerful group chorus on every chorus, call-and-response, verses light and bouncy, pre-chorus builds with a rising snare roll, chorus explodes with full band and group vocals, short claps-and-stomps breakdown, final chorus modulates up a whole step with the biggest energy, vocals start right away on the first beat with the chorus, no instrumental intro, short punchy ending
lyrics:
[Chorus - full band, group vocals]
Big and small, big and small,
Short friends, tall friends, we love them all!
Opposites, opposites, sing along,
Big and small in the zoo song!

[Verse 1 - light and bouncy]
The elephant is big, so big,
Milo is small, a little twig!
The giraffe is tall, way up there,
The hippo's legs are short, I swear!

[Pre-Chorus - build up, rising drums]
Stretch up big, then crouch down small,
Ready, friends? Let's sing it all!

[Chorus - full band, group vocals]
Big and small, big and small,
Short friends, tall friends, we love them all!
Opposites, opposites, sing along,
Big and small in the zoo song!

[Verse 2 - light and bouncy]
The zebra runs fast, zoom, zoom, zoom,
The sleepy lion is slow, yawn, boom!
The hippo is loud, splash and spray,
Milo whispers, tweet, hooray!

[Bridge - claps and stomps, call and response]
Make it big! (Big, big, big!)
Make it small! (Small, small, small!)
Go up high! (High, high!)
Now go down low and that is all!

[Verse 3 - light and bouncy]
Up and down and in and out,
Open wide and give a shout!
Every friend is different, it's true,
Big or small, we all love you!

[Pre-Chorus - build up, rising drums]
Stretch up big, then crouch down small,
Ready, friends? Let's sing it all!

[Final Chorus - key change up, biggest energy, everyone sings]
Big and small, big and small,
Short friends, tall friends, we love them all!
Opposites, opposites, we sang along,
Big and small, the zoo friends' song!

[Outro - quick and happy]
Big and small! Bye-bye, friends!

meta.title: Big and Small at the Zoo! Opposites Song with Milo
meta.description:
Big and small at the zoo! Learn opposites with Milo the bluebird and his animal friends: big and small, tall and short, fast and slow, loud and quiet.
An opposites song for kids: stretch up big, crouch down small and sing along. Ages 2-6.

The Animated Zoo makes gentle, colorful videos for little learners. New videos every day! Made with care for ages 2-6. Characters and visuals are animated with the help of AI tools and reviewed for kid safety before publishing.
